descriptions.d26c_actor_apply_impulse_800d9c74: When Desc+288 is positive and the impulse is non-zero, read position and velocity through virtuals +44 and +48 at the context time, store position at +36 and the summed velocity at +48, clamp the vertical part up to 0.3 times the impulse length, then run 0x800eb6e4, store the time at +368, run 0x800d8b4c and clear +300.
